recipes.name: Tequila Sunrise
instructions: Pour tequila and orange juice in a tall glass. Scale up recipe as required for your glass side (1 part tequila to 3 parts OJ)!
Drizzle grenadine down the side of the glass over the back of a teaspoon (see video). Do not mix!
Garnish with orange slice and Maraschino cherry. Serve immediately!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: Tequila – use a mid range one which, in Australia, is around the $40 to $50 range. Reserve the better stuff for drinking straight! I use Jose Cuervo which is a top-mid range Mexican tequila. Orange juice – the fresher the better! Avoid the sweet reconstituted stuff with loads of added sugar. Grenadine syrup – a non alcoholic red sugar syrup made from concentrated pomegranate juice. This is what makes Tequila Sunrise red – see video! Maraschino Cherries – sold in Dan Murphys in Australia! If you can’t find them, just use normal glace cherries sold in the baking aisle of supermarkets – it won’t have the stems but they still look good!
